name: Introduction and overview — MiG-21 — aircraft record
title: Introduction and overview — MiG-21
description: Introduction and overview of the MiG-21: What this aircraft is, its role, and why it matters in aviation history. The MiG-21 is a single-engine supersonic fighter built by Mikoyan-Gurevich, entering service in 1959. With 11,496 built, it is the most-produced supersonic jet in history, serving over 60 air forces. Its simple delta-wing design fought in Vietnam, the Middle East, and dozens of conflicts; many remain in service. Baseline facts: Single-engine supersonic fighter; 11,496 built by Mikoyan-Gurevich; most-produced supersonic jet ever..
how_it_works: Wings generate lift from airflow; the engine provides thrust; control surfaces and fly-by-wire or mechanical controls steer the aircraft in three axes.
key_points: MiG-21: What this aircraft is, its role, and why it matters in aviation history.

description: Maintenance and operations of the MiG-21: What it takes to keep this aircraft flying: inspections, spares, and support. The MiG-21 is a single-engine supersonic fighter built by Mikoyan-Gurevich, entering service in 1959. With 11,496 built, it is the most-produced supersonic jet in history, serving over 60 air forces. Its simple delta-wing design fought in Vietnam, the Middle East, and dozens of conflicts; many remain in service. Baseline facts: Single-engine supersonic fighter; 11,496 built by Mikoyan-Gurevich; most-produced supersonic jet ever..
how_it_works: Wings generate lift from airflow; the engine provides thrust; control surfaces and fly-by-wire or mechanical controls steer the aircraft in three axes.
